The Tribe, led by first-year head coach [[Dane Fischer]], played their home games at [[Kaplan Arena]] in [[Williamsburg, Virginia]] as members of the [[Colonial Athletic Association]]. ==Previous season== The [[2018–19 William & Mary Tribe men's basketball team|Tribe]] finished the [[2018–19 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2018–19 season]] 14–17, 10–6 in CAA play to finish in fourth place.
